requirements.text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. shall be affixed to every ESA (rear combination lamp electronics) conforming to a type approved under UN R10; no marking is required if the electrical/electronic system is built into a vehicle approved as a unit.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of production samples: the approval mark per paragraph 5.3. is present on each ESA approved under R10; pass if the mark is present, or if the lamp is only covered by whole-vehicle approval.

requirements.text: When the approval mark is affixed to the ESA according to paragraph 5.2. of this Regulation (Model A or Model B), the dimension a of the approval mark shall be 6 mm min.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection and measurement of the affixed approval mark against Annex 1 Model A/B. Pass if dimension a ≥ 6 mm and the layout matches the model.

requirements.text: The ESA (rear combination lamp with its LED light sources, PCB(s), internal wiring and connector) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Design review plus ESA EMC test results (radiated/conducted emissions and immunity per UN R10 ESA annexes) in representative operating modes (position, stop, reversing lamps on); pass if all applicable ESA limits are met and the lamp is fitted per manufacturer installation instructions

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested for radiated emissions.
requirements.test_case: UN R10 Annex 7 (broadband) and Annex 8 (narrowband) ESA radiated emission tests with all lamp functions energised; pass if emissions remain below the ESA reference limits

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested for conducted emissions.
requirements.test_case: UN R10 Annex 10 conducted transient emission test on the supply lines (switching of position, stop and reversing functions); pass if pulse amplitudes stay within the specified limits

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances.
requirements.test_case: UN R10 Annex 9 ESA immunity test at the specified field strength over the required frequency range with lamp functions active; pass if no degradation of lamp functions (no flicker, unintended switching or loss of light output) per the test plan failure criteria

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested for immunity to conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: UN R10 Annex 10 conducted transient immunity test on the supply lines with lamp functions active; pass if the lamp functions meet the required functional status per the test plan

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limit in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 measurement, 30-75 MHz; pass if broadband emissions are below the 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m logarithmically decreasing limit (Appendix 6).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limit in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 measurement, 75-400 MHz; pass if broadband emissions are below the 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m logarithmically increasing limit (Appendix 6).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 measurement, 400-1,000 MHz; pass if broadband emissions are below 63 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 measurement over 30-1,000 MHz with all functions operating; pass if all measured values are below the limits of paragraph 6.5.2.1.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 narrowband measurement from 30 to 75 MHz; pass if the measured level is below a limit falling logarithmically from 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m (Appendix 7).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 narrowband measurement from 75 to 400 MHz; pass if the measured level is below a limit rising logarithmically from 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m (Appendix 7).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 narrowband measurement from 400 to 1,000 MHz; pass if the measured level is below 53 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 measurement with each function (rear position, stop, reversing) operating; compare all measured values against the limits of paragraph 6.6.2.1; pass if every value is below the limit.

requirements.text: For vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on the supply lines shall be +75 V.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 measurement on 12 V supply lines; pass if the positive pulse amplitude is ≤ +75 V.

requirements.text: For vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on the supply lines shall be -100 V.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 measurement on 12 V supply lines; pass if the negative pulse amplitude does not exceed -100 V in magnitude.

requirements.text: For vehicles with 24 V systems, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on the supply lines shall be +150 V.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 measurement on 24 V supply lines; pass if the positive pulse amplitude is ≤ +150 V.

requirements.text: For vehicles with 24 V systems, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on the supply lines shall be -450 V.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 measurement on 24 V supply lines; pass if the negative pulse amplitude does not exceed -450 V in magnitude.

requirements.text: When tested with the stripline method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 stripline test, 20 to 400 MHz; pass if 60 V/m is applied over more than 90 per cent of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the stripline method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a minimum test level of 50 V/m over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 stripline test, 20 to 400 MHz; pass if at least 50 V/m is applied at every frequency of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the TEM cell method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 75 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 200 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell test, 20 to 200 MHz; pass if 75 V/m is applied over more than 90 per cent of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the TEM cell method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a minimum test level of 62,5 V/m over the whole 20 to 200 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell test, 20 to 200 MHz; pass if at least 62,5 V/m is applied at every frequency of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the BCI method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 bulk current injection test, 20 to 400 MHz; pass if 60 mA is injected over more than 90 per cent of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the BCI method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a minimum test level of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 bulk current injection test, 20 to 400 MHz; pass if at least 50 mA is injected at every frequency of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the ALSE method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 30 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 absorber-lined shielded enclosure test, 80 to 2,000 MHz; pass if 30 V/m is applied over more than 90 per cent of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the ALSE method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 10 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 ALSE test, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz; pass if 10 V/m is applied over more than 90 per cent of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the ALSE method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a minimum test level of 25 V/m over the whole 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 ALSE test, 80 to 2,000 MHz; pass if at least 25 V/m is applied at every frequency of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the ALSE method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a minimum test level of 8 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 ALSE test, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz; pass if at least 8 V/m is applied at every frequency of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the reverberation chamber method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 21 V/m in over 90 per cent of the LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, LUF to 2,000 MHz; pass if 21 V/m is applied over more than 90 per cent of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the reverberation chamber method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 7 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz; pass if 7 V/m is applied over more than 90 per cent of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the reverberation chamber method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a minimum test level of 18 V/m over the whole LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, LUF to 2,000 MHz; pass if at least 18 V/m is applied at every frequency of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: When tested with the reverberation chamber method described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a minimum test level of 6 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz; pass if at least 6 V/m is applied at every frequency of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: During the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" of the ESA representative of its type.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 immunity test at Table 2a/2b levels with each lamp function operated; pass if no flicker, extinction, unintended activation or intensity change of the stop, rear position or reversing lamps is observed.

requirements.text: The immunity of the ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 conducted transient immunity test on the 12/24 V supply lines per ISO 16750-2 (starting profile) and ISO 7637-2 (pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b) at the Table 3a/3b levels; pass if the required functional status/FPSC is met for each pulse.

requirements.text: The ESA shall be assessed for the starting profile according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: During and after the ISO 16750-2 starting profile test, classify lamp behaviour per ISO 16750-1 functional status; pass if the class required by Table 3a is achieved.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied to the ESA for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: During and after each ISO 7637-2 pulse test, classify lamp behaviour per ISO 7637-1 FPSC; pass if the class required by Table 3b is achieved.

requirements.text: When tested with the starting profile at immunity test level II (12 V system and 24 V system) with 10 pulses, an ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases shall meet functional status B for immunity related functions and functional status D for functions not related to immunity related functions; other ESAs shall meet functional status C.
requirements.test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile, level II, 10 pulses, per Annex 10; pass if functional status B (immunity related, operational during engine start), D (not immunity related) or C (other ESA) per ISO 16750-1.

requirements.text: When tested with test pulse 1 at -75 V (12 V system) or -450 V (24 V system) for 500 pulses, the ESA shall meet FPSC III for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 1, -75 V (12 V) / -450 V (24 V), 500 pulses, per Annex 10; pass if FPSC III per ISO 7637-1.

requirements.text: When tested with test pulse 2a at +37 V (12 V system) or +37 V (24 V system) for 500 pulses, the ESA shall meet FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a, +37 V (12 V and 24 V), 500 pulses, per Annex 10; pass if FPSC I (immunity related) / III (not immunity related) per ISO 7637-1.

requirements.text: When tested with test pulse 2b at +10 V (12 V system) or +20 V (24 V system) for 10 pulses, the ESA shall meet FPSC II for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2b, +10 V (12 V) / +20 V (24 V), 10 pulses, per Annex 10; pass if FPSC II (immunity related) / III (not immunity related) per ISO 7637-1.

requirements.text: When tested with test pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V system) or -150 V (24 V system) for a test duration of 1 h, the ESA shall meet FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a, -112 V (12 V) / -150 V (24 V), 1 h, per Annex 10; pass if FPSC I (immunity related) / III (not immunity related) per ISO 7637-1.

requirements.text: When tested with test pulse 3b at +75 V (12 V system) or +150 V (24 V system) for a test duration of 1 h, the ESA shall meet FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3b, +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V), 1 h, per Annex 10; pass if FPSC I (immunity related) / III (not immunity related) per ISO 7637-1.

requirements.text: The starting profile test shall be applied to the ESA if it could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Review of intended vehicle installations; if the lamp may be fitted to M1 vehicles with ICE and 12V/24V starter motor, verify the starting profile test was performed and passed.

requirements.text: Where the ESA (rear combination lamp) does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, the ESA shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.6.2. and with Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Design review of the circuit diagram and component list: confirm that no electronic oscillator (e.g. switching LED driver, PWM controller, microcontroller clock) operates above 9 kHz. If confirmed, the Annex 8 radiated emission test may be waived; otherwise, test per Annex 8 to the limits of paragraph 6.6.2.

requirements.text: Where the ESA (rear combination lamp) is not switched, contains no switches or does not include inductive load, the ESA need not be tested for transient conducted emission on 12/24 V supply lines and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
requirements.test_case: Review the schematic for internal switches, switched operation and inductive loads (e.g. inductors in switching regulators). If none, document the exemption. Otherwise, measure transient conducted emissions on the 12/24 V supply lines per the method referenced in paragraph 6.7 and confirm the limits are met.

requirements.text: When the conformity of the rear combination lamp (ESA) taken from the series is being verified, the broadband electromagnetic disturbance levels measured shall not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.5.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1.
requirements.test_case: CoP sample from series: broadband emission measurement per Annex 7 method; pass if measured levels <= reference limits of 6.5.2.1 (and 7.10.2.1 if applicable) + 4 dB

requirements.text: When the conformity of the rear combination lamp (ESA) taken from the series is being verified, the narrowband electromagnetic disturbance levels measured shall not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.6.2.1.
requirements.test_case: CoP sample from series: narrowband emission measurement per Annex 8 method; pass if measured levels <= reference limits of 6.6.2.1 + 4 dB

requirements.text: When the conformity of the rear combination lamp (ESA) taken from the series is being verified, the ESA shall not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1.
requirements.test_case: CoP sample from series: radiated immunity test per Annex 9 at field strength up to 80 % of limits of 6.8.2.1 (and 7.18.2.1 if applicable); pass if no observable degradation of lamp functions (e.g. no flicker, loss or unintended activation)

requirements.text: If the conformity of the rear combination lamp (component or STU) taken from the series is being verified, the component shall show no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to the levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1.
requirements.test_case: CoP sample from series: conducted transient immunity test per Annex 10 up to levels of 6.9.1 (and 7.19.1 if applicable); pass if no degradation of stop/position/reversing functions

requirements.text: If the conformity of the rear combination lamp (component or STU) taken from the series is being verified, the component shall not exceed the conducted emission levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.
requirements.test_case: CoP sample from series: conducted transient emission test per Annex 10; pass if emissions do not exceed levels of 6.7.1 (and 7.17.1 if applicable)

requirements.text: The broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the ESA (LED light sources and electronics of the rear combination lamp), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.), shall not exceed in the 30-75 MHz frequency band the limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m, where F is the frequency in MHz.
requirements.test_case: ESA broadband emission measurement per paragraph 6.5.2.1. / 7.10.2.1. (Annex 7 method), 120 kHz bandwidth, lamp functions energised, scan 30-75 MHz; pass if all measured values are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m

requirements.text: The broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the ESA, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.), shall not exceed in the 75-400 MHz frequency band the limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m, where F is the frequency in MHz.
requirements.test_case: ESA broadband emission measurement per paragraph 6.5.2.1. / 7.10.2.1. (Annex 7 method), 120 kHz bandwidth, lamp functions energised, scan 75-400 MHz; pass if all measured values are at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m

requirements.text: The broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the ESA, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.), shall not exceed in the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band the constant limit E = 63 dBµV/m.
requirements.test_case: ESA broadband emission measurement per paragraph 6.5.2.1. / 7.10.2.1. (Annex 7 method), 120 kHz bandwidth, lamp functions energised, scan 400-1,000 MHz; pass if all measured values are at or below 63 dBµV/m

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8 (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.), the narrowband electromagnetic radiation limit of the ESA in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dB microvolts/m, for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 ESA narrowband radiated emission test, 120 kHz bandwidth, 30-75 MHz; pass if measured values ≤ 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at each frequency F (MHz).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8 (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.), the narrowband electromagnetic radiation limit of the ESA in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dB microvolts/m, for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 ESA narrowband radiated emission test, 120 kHz bandwidth, 75-400 MHz; pass if measured values ≤ 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at each frequency F (MHz).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8 (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.), the narrowband electromagnetic radiation limit of the ESA in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m, for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 ESA narrowband radiated emission test, 120 kHz bandwidth, 400-1,000 MHz; pass if measured values ≤ 53 dBµV/m throughout the band.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load, during the broadband emission test.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 paragraph 2.1: confirm the lamp is operated in normal mode with the maximum-load function combination (rear position, stop and reversing LEDs ON at rated voltage) throughout the measurement; pass if the operating state is documented and kept for the whole scan.

requirements.text: The broadband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 paragraph 4.1: scan 30 to 1,000 MHz in ALSE or OATS; pass if the emissions remain below the paragraph 6.5. broadband limits over the whole range.

requirements.text: During the narrowband radiated emission tests, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 test; operate the lamp in normal operation mode, preferably with all functions (rear position, stop, reversing) energised at maximum load; confirm and record the operating state in the test report.

requirements.text: The narrowband radiated emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 test in ALSE/OATS; scan 30 to 1,000 MHz; pass if the emissions stay below the para. 6.6.2.1 narrowband limits over the whole range.

requirements.text: The narrowband radiated emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 test; verify the receiver or analyser detector is set to average.

requirements.text: The ESA shall comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that the results cover the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 9: absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3, bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4, stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5, or reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Review test plan and reports: confirm that the selected ISO 11452 methods together cover 20 to 6,000 MHz with no gaps; pass if full range covered and ESA meets immunity requirements in each method.

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions for ESA immunity testing shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check test report references ISO 11452-1 for frequency range and general conditions; pass if conformant.

requirements.text: The test conditions for the ESA immunity tests shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Audit test conditions (temperature, supply voltage, ground plane etc.) against ISO 11452-1; pass if all conditions conform.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition during the immunity tests.
requirements.test_case: During Annex 9 tests, energise rear position, stop and reversing functions in normal operating mode; pass if all functions are verified active throughout the test.

requirements.text: All cables in the wiring harness of the ESA under test should be terminated as realistically as possible and preferably with real loads and actuators.
requirements.test_case: Inspect harness terminations in test setup; pass if realistic/real loads used.

requirements.text: Immunity measurements on the ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check test report frequency sweep covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 step sizes; pass if ESA operates without malfunction across range.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify signal generator settings in 20 to 400 MHz: AM 1 kHz, 80 % depth; pass if conformant.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify signal generator settings in 2,700 to 3,100 MHz: PM2, Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs; pass if conformant.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify signal generator settings in 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz: PM3, Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs; pass if conformant.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check step size and dwell time in test report against ISO 11452-1; pass if conformant.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be immune to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply when tested according to the method of Annex 10.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 conducted transient immunity test per ISO 7637-2 and ISO 16750-2; pass if lamp functions meet the immunity criteria of the Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall limit conducted transients from the ESA to the vehicle power supply when tested according to the method of Annex 10.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 conducted transient emission measurement per ISO 7637-2; pass if emitted transients are within the limits specified.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to supply and operationally connected lines; verify immunity performance status of all lamp functions.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines, unless the ESA is exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor).
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 16750-2 starting profile to supply and operationally connected lines; verify lamp functions remain within immunity criteria.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of drawings and sample: a marking area large enough for the approval marking and the markings of 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6. is provided.

requirements.text: The markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection for legibility; durability check (e.g. rubbing with water- and petroleum-soaked cloth): markings remain legible.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval mark dimension "a" on the sample: a >= 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: circle surrounding "E" and the distinguishing number of the approving country is present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: four to six-digit sequential number matching the approval number is present.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2. shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: sequential number is located adjacent to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: symbols for rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp per 3.2.4 are present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: "148R" followed by the correct two-digit series of amendments is present.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of each handed unit: horizontal arrow present indicating the mounting position.

requirements.text: In the case of rear position lamps, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection with lamp in mounting orientation: arrow points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps with reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: If reduced light distribution applies, visual inspection with lamp in mounting orientation: arrow points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: If applicable, the additional letter "D" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: "D" to the right of the relevant function symbol where applicable.

requirements.text: If applicable, the additional letter "Y" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: "Y" to the right of the relevant function symbol where applicable.

requirements.text: On lamps with reduced light distribution (see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3), the approval marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: If reduced light distribution applies, visual inspection: vertical downward arrow from a horizontal segment present.

requirements.text: The lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: approval marking present on the lamp.

requirements.text: The lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: applicant trade name or mark present.

requirements.text: Lamps with an electronic light source control gear, a variable luminous intensity control, a secondary operating mode and/or non-replaceable light sources shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: rated voltage (e.g. 12V) or voltage range is marked on the lamp.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant, the specific identification code of the module (starting letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1., followed by additional symbols or characters in case several non-identical modules are used) and the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: If replaceable modules are used, visual inspection of each module: trade name, MD identification code and rated voltage present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii) and the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: If replaceable modules are used, visual inspection of lamp: module identification code and rated voltage present.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: If external control gear exists, visual inspection: identification number and manufacturer name present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of design: marking located on a part not separable from the light-emitting outer lens.

requirements.text: The approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: Inspection on vehicle: approval marking visible with lamp installed or after opening boot lid/door.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of the device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: If lens is detachable, visual inspection: approval marking on both lens and housing.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: each main body carries only the approval marking of its own functions.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: listed markings located on the lamp itself.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a) shall be affixed on the light source module.
requirements.test_case: If replaceable modules are used, visual inspection: module markings on the module component.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, it shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Inspection on vehicle: single approval mark visible after installation.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Design inspection: no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure mark components: not smaller than the minimum size of the smallest individual mark required (e.g. R148, R150).

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval (rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp) shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify by review of the compliance matrix and test reports that each lamp function meets all general technical requirements of paragraph 4. and all photometric/colorimetric and other requirements of paragraph 5. of UN R148; pass if every applicable provision is met.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulation No. 48, and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, shall apply to the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector of the rear combination lamp.
requirements.test_case: Review against UN R48 sections 5 and 6 and referenced Annexes (series in force at application date); pass if each applicable provision verifiable at lamp level is met.

requirements.text: The requirements of UN Regulation No. 48 pertinent to each lamp function and to vehicle category M1, on which the lamp is intended to be installed, shall be applied where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Compile a per-function checklist of UN R48 provisions for M1 verifiable at lamp level (e.g. geometric visibility angles, colour, number, apparent surface); verify each on lamp samples in intended mounting orientation; pass if all are compliant.

requirements.text: The lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamps) shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which the lamps may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured.
requirements.test_case: Design review and vibration/durability testing representative of normal vehicle use (e.g. manufacturer vibration profile on mounting fixture); after exposure all functions shall light correctly with no mechanical damage, loosened parts or electrical failure.

requirements.text: The lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamps) shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which the lamps may be subjected in such use, the lamps retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: After vibration/durability exposure representative of normal use, re-measure photometric intensities and colorimetric characteristics per UN R148 procedures; values shall remain within the prescribed limits for each function.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp or stop lamp is type approved as an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D", this shall be applied only to front and rear position lamps, stop lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, daytime running lamps and direction indicator lamps (not to the reversing lamp).
requirements.test_case: Review of the type approval documentation and markings: the "D" marking appears only on the rear position and/or stop lamp functions and never on the reversing lamp function.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp or stop lamp is type approved as an interdependent lamp system marked "Y", this shall be applied only to front and rear position lamps, stop lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, daytime running lamps and direction indicator lamps (not to the reversing lamp).
requirements.test_case: Review of the type approval documentation and markings: the "Y" marking appears only on the rear position and/or stop lamp functions and never on the reversing lamp function.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, these functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source) or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Design review of the light source architecture and circuit: confirm separate light sources for the rear position and stop functions, or a documented intended use with a vehicle failure tell-tale. Pass if either condition is met.

requirements.text: If the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside the apparent surface of the rear position lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, only one logo, built by transparent or non-transparent components, shall be incorporated, and all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation shall be fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection for the number of logos, then full photometric and colorimetric testing of the rear position function with the logo present. Pass if there is at most one logo and all function requirements are met.

requirements.text: If a logo is incorporated within the apparent surface of the rear position lamp, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer shall be allowed.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the logo against the applicant's statement (paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f)). Pass if the logo is solely the vehicle or body manufacturer's brand logo.

requirements.text: If a logo is incorporated within the apparent surface of the rear position lamp, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projected enclosed logo area in the direction of the reference axis. Pass if it is ≤ 100 cm2.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the stop lamp's apparent surface, optical components and outer lens texture. Pass if no logo is present.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the reversing lamp's apparent surface, optical components and outer lens texture. Pass if no logo is present.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the circuit diagram and inspect the LED PCB wiring. Disconnect one LED of each group and confirm that the whole group stops emitting light. Where it does, treat the group as one light source in the failure assessment of 4.6.1.2.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in the rear position lamp containing more than one light source, either the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3, with the maximum intensities not exceeded when all light sources are illuminated, or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure as indicated in paragraph 6.10.8. of UN Regulation No. 48 shall be produced.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of each single light source (or group) in turn and measure on the Annex 3 grid: every point shall be at or above the minimum. With all sources lit, the maximum shall not be exceeded. Alternatively, verify that the failure output signal for the tell-tale is produced on each simulated failure.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in the stop lamp containing more than one light source, either the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3, with the maximum intensities not exceeded when all light sources are illuminated, or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure as indicated in paragraph 6.7.8. of UN Regulation No. 48 shall be produced.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of each single light source (or group) in turn and measure on the Annex 3 grid: every point shall be at or above the minimum. With all sources lit, the maximum shall not be exceeded. Alternatively, verify that the failure output signal for the tell-tale is produced on each simulated failure.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in the reversing lamp containing more than one light source, either the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3, with the maximum intensities not exceeded when all light sources are illuminated, or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure as indicated in paragraph 6.4.8. of UN Regulation No. 48 shall be produced.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of each single light source (or group) in turn and measure on the Annex 3 grid: every point shall be at or above the minimum. With all sources lit, the maximum shall not be exceeded. Alternatively, verify that the failure output signal for the tell-tale is produced on each simulated failure.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, in case of failure of the variable intensity control the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control (e.g. open or short the control input) and measure intensity per Annex 3. The lamp shall automatically meet the steady-intensity requirements of its category without exceeding them.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, in case of failure of the variable intensity control the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control (e.g. open or short the control input) and measure intensity per Annex 3. The lamp shall automatically meet the steady-intensity requirements of its category without exceeding them.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Design review and inspection of the bill of materials and samples: every light source is a UN R37/R99/R128 approved replaceable light source without use restriction, a light source module, or a non-replaceable light source; pass if no other light source type is present.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Physical fitting trial: attempt to insert the light source in all possible orientations; pass if it can only be fixed in the correct position.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying.
requirements.test_case: Dimensional inspection of the holder against the relevant IEC 60061 holder data sheet; pass if all dimensions and characteristics conform.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the light source(s) holder shall conform to the holder data sheet of IEC Publication 60061 relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Dimensional inspection of the holder against the IEC 60061 holder data sheet for the LED substitute light source category; pass if conforming.

requirements.text: The light signalling devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: EMC testing of radiated and conducted (power line) emissions at vehicle level (e.g. per UN R10); pass if no malfunction of other vehicle electric/electronic systems occurs.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the module can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
requirements.test_case: Fitting trial in all possible positions and orientations; pass if the module can only be fitted in the designated correct position.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the module can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Removal trial without tools; pass if the module cannot be removed without tool(s).

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the module is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspection and tamper attempt on the module; pass if the module cannot be opened or altered without evident damage.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), the module is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
requirements.test_case: Interchangeability check: attempt to fit UN approved replaceable light sources into the module location and vice versa; pass if not possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), the module is not interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Cross-fitting trial of every module in each other module position in the housing; pass if modules with different characteristics cannot be interchanged.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace module with another sample bearing the same identification code and repeat photometric measurements; pass if all photometric requirements are met.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities of the lamp shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.test_case: Photometry with LEDs continuously lit (steady operation); pass if setup confirms continuous operation.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Measure supply voltage at lamp connector during tests; pass if 13.5 V (12 V system) or applicable nominal test voltage.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Operate lamp with applicant-specified control gear and settings during tests; pass if operating conditions match applicant specification.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Operate lamp at applicant-specified conditions during photometry; pass if conditions match specification.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Annex 3 photometry of both samples at HV; pass if ≥ paragraph 5 minimum for each function.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric scan of visible field for both samples; pass if no value exceeds paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure each grid point of Annex 3 light distribution figure; pass if each value ≥ minimum × percentage or ≥ specified value.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure within Annex 2 geometric visibility angles; pass if all values ≥ paragraph 5 minimum (as applicable).

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visual examination and intermediate measurements per Annex 3 local variation provisions; pass if criteria met.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously to the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.test_case: Measure rear position alone and rear position+stop together over ±5° V / ±10° H grid; pass if ratio ≥ 5:1 at every point.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed for the light emitted by the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Visual/colorimetric inspection of emitted light outside the Annex 3 grid field; pass if no sharp colour variation is observed.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1 and Annex 3; pass if every sample meets all Table 4 values for its category.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) shall be 4∙10^0 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement in the reference axis per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if luminous intensity ≥ 4 cd.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady) and used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 1.7∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement over the full distribution per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no value exceeds 17 cd (except where the 60 cd allowance applies).

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady) and is a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 8.5∙10^0 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no value exceeds 8.5 cd.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) shall be 4∙10^0 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement in the reference axis per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (a) at all intensity levels; pass if luminous intensity ≥ 4 cd.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable) and used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 4.2∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b) at all intensity levels; pass if no value exceeds 42 cd.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 (variable) and is a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 2.1∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no value exceeds 21 cd.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall meet the standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) defined in Figure A3-I and Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity at the grid points of Figure A3-I per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if each point meets the percentage of minimum intensity given in Table A2-1.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement below 5° down; pass if luminous intensity in that zone ≤ 60 cd and elsewhere ≤ the Table 4 maximum.

requirements.text: Within the angles of geometric visibility (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp shall be not less than 5∙10^-2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity throughout the angles of geometric visibility per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if every value ≥ 0.05 cd.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light per the colour test method of the Regulation; pass if trichromatic coordinates lie within the red boundaries defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1 and Annex 2/3; pass if all Table 7 values for the declared category are met on each sample.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity in the reference axis (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on reference axis per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if intensity ≥ 60 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady) and used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 2.60∙10^2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if maximum intensity ≤ 260 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady) and is a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 1.30∙10^2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if maximum intensity ≤ 130 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady), the standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) shall be as defined in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure at the grid points of Annex 2 Table A2-1 per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if each point meets the required percentage of the minimum intensity.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)) shall be 3∙10^-1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Measure throughout the geometric visibility field of Annex 3 Figure A3-I per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if intensity ≥ 0.3 cd everywhere.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity in the reference axis (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement on reference axis per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if intensity ≥ 60 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable) and used as a single lamp, the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 7.30∙10^2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if maximum intensity ≤ 730 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable) and is a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 3.65∙10^2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if maximum intensity ≤ 365 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), the standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) shall be as defined in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure at the grid points of Annex 2 Table A2-1 per paragraph 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if each point meets the required percentage of the minimum intensity.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)) shall be 3∙10^-1 cd (day).
requirements.test_case: Measure in day mode throughout the geometric visibility field of Annex 3 Figure A3-I; pass if intensity ≥ 0.3 cd everywhere.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)) shall be 7∙10^-2 cd (night).
requirements.test_case: Measure in night mode throughout the geometric visibility field of Annex 3 Figure A3-I; pass if intensity ≥ 0.07 cd everywhere.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light; pass if trichromatic coordinates lie within the red colour boundaries defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp (category AR) supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 8.0∙10^1 cd as given in Table 10 (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (a)).
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1 at the reference axis/standard light distribution points; pass if intensity ≥ 8.0∙10^1 cd

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp (category AR) shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 3.00∙10^2 cd in or above the h-plane, as given in Table 10 (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric scan of both samples in and above the h-plane; pass if no value > 3.00∙10^2 cd

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp (category AR) shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 6.00∙10^2 cd below the h-plane, down to 5°D, as given in Table 10 (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric scan of both samples from h-plane down to 5°D; pass if no value > 6.00∙10^2 cd

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp (category AR) shall not exceed a maximum luminous intensity of 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D, as given in Table 10 (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric scan of both samples below 5°D; pass if no value > 8.00∙10^3 cd

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp (category AR) shall comply with the standard light distribution defined in Figure A3-V (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (c)).
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples at the grid points of Figure A3-V (Annex 3); pass if each point meets the required percentage of the minimum intensity

requirements.text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement at 30° inwards on both samples; pass if intensity ≥ 2.5∙10^1 cd

requirements.text: Where type approval of the reversing lamp is granted applying the pair-only condition, the reversing lamp shall only be installed on the vehicle in a pair.
requirements.test_case: Check communication form paragraph 9.1.3 and vehicle installation; pass if two reversing lamps are fitted as a pair

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light per paragraph 4 colour method; pass if trichromatic coordinates are within the white colour limits defined in UN Regulation No. 48

requirements.text: No measured value of the lamps shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of production samples per Annexes 2 and 3 at prescribed test points; pass if each value is within 20 per cent unfavourable deviation of the prescribed minimum/maximum.

requirements.text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12: required minimum 7∙10-1 cd equivalent to 5∙10-1 cd (20 per cent) and 3∙10-1 cd (30 per cent); 6∙10-1 cd equivalent to 4∙10-1 cd and 2∙10-1 cd; 3∙10-1 cd equivalent to 2∙10-1 cd and 1∙10-1 cd; 7∙10-2 cd equivalent to 5∙10-2 cd and 3∙10-2 cd; 5∙10-2 cd equivalent to 3∙10-2 cd and 2∙10-2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement throughout the fields of Annexes 2 and 3 on production samples; pass if measured values meet the Table 12 equivalent 20 per cent (or 30 per cent where Annex 5 applies) values.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard and 80° outboard; however, for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced angles of 20° inboard and 80° outboard may be used only below the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per Annex 2 Table A2-1 (CAD/goniometric sight-line analysis of the installed lamp at its intended outboard rear mounting position and height). Pass: the apparent surface is unobstructed across 45° inboard to 80° outboard, or 20°/80° below the H-plane when mounted below 750 mm.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above and 15° below the horizontal; however, for lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, 15° above and 5° below may be used, and for optional lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm, 5° above and 15° below may be used.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per Annex 2 Table A2-1 at the declared H-plane mounting height. Pass: the apparent surface is unobstructed across 15° up/15° down, or 15°/5° when the H-plane is below 750 mm, or 5°/15° when it is above 2,100 mm (optional lamp).

requirements.text: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard and 45° outboard; however, for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced angles of 20° inboard and 45° outboard may be used only below the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per Annex 2 Table A2-1 of the installed lamp. Pass: the apparent surface is unobstructed across 45° inboard to 45° outboard, or 20°/45° below the H-plane when mounted below 750 mm.

requirements.text: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above and 15° below the horizontal; however, for lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, 15° above and 5° below may be used, and for optional lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm, 5° above and 15° below may be used.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per Annex 2 Table A2-1 at the declared H-plane mounting height. Pass: the apparent surface is unobstructed across 15° up/15° down, or 15°/5° when the H-plane is below 750 mm, or 5°/15° when it is above 2,100 mm (optional lamp).

requirements.text: The angles of geometric visibility of Annex 2 shall be applied as shown for lamps mounted on the right side of the vehicle and mirrored (inboard/outboard) for the opposite-side lamp.
requirements.test_case: Review the geometric visibility analysis of both handed units. Pass: the inboard and outboard angles are correctly assigned relative to the vehicle longitudinal axis for the right-side unit as drawn and for the mirrored left-side unit.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 3 grid relative to the reference axis (H = 0°, V = 0°). Check that each derived minimum value is rounded down to three significant digits. Pass if every measured intensity is at least the derived minimum.

requirements.text: In the case where the rear position lamp is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer's declared mounting height. If it is ≤ 750 mm, measure the Figure A3-I points down to 5° below H only. Pass if the minima are met in the reduced field.

requirements.text: In the case where the stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer's declared mounting height. If it is ≤ 750 mm, measure the Figure A3-I points down to 5° below H only. Pass if the minima are met in the reduced field.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution of the rear position lamp schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric scan between the grid points of Figure A3-I. Pass if the intensity at every intermediate direction is at least the lowest surrounding grid minimum.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution of the stop lamp schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric scan between the grid points of Figure A3-I. Pass if the intensity at every intermediate direction is at least the lowest surrounding grid minimum.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution of the reversing lamp schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric scan between the grid points of Figure A3-V. Pass if the intensity at every intermediate direction is at least the lowest surrounding grid minimum.

requirements.text: When visual examination of a reversing lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement of the grid shall be below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: Perform a visual examination. If substantial local variations are seen, measure between adjacent Figure A3-V points. Pass if every value is ≥ 50 % of the lower of the two prescribed minima.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8) given by the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement at the Figure A3-I points with the applicable table minimum applied. Pass if all points are ≥ the stated percentage of the required minimum.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of category S1 or S2 shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 7) given by the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement at the Figure A3-I points with the Table 7 minimum applied. Pass if all points are ≥ the stated percentage of the required minimum.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit, at the measuring points expressed in degrees of angle with the axis of reference, at least the minimum intensities in cd shown in Figure A3-V.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement at the Figure A3-V points relative to the reference axis (H = 0°, V = 0°). Pass if every point is ≥ the cd value shown in Figure A3-V.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the lamp functions shall be complied with when tested under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. of UN R148; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the prescribed boundaries.

requirements.text: From a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, the mass-produced rear combination lamp shall conform to the requirements of this Regulation, with differences not exceeding inevitable manufacturing deviations.
requirements.test_case: Conformity of production check: dimensional/mechanical inspection of randomly sampled lamps against the approved type; pass if deviations do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

requirements.text: When testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation on any lamp chosen at random, no measured value of the mass-produced lamp shall deviate from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: CoP photometric test per paragraph 4.8. on randomly chosen lamps; pass if no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the light emitted by the mass-produced lamp shall be complied with when tested under the conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement under the conditions of paragraph 4.9.; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the prescribed colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The approval marking arrangement of the rear combination lamp shall be made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation; the arrangements shown in Annex 7 are given merely as examples.
