requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the marking on the lamp against paragraph 3.3. of UN R148, using the Annex 7 examples for grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps (Figure A7-III) as reference. Pass if every approved function and its symbol (e.g. R/R2, S/S2, AR, retro-reflector class), the E-mark, the approval number and the series of amendments are arranged in accordance with paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: If the rear combination lamp contains light source modules, each light source module shall bear an identification code consisting of 'MD' followed by the approval mark (E-number) and the approval number of the lamp with which it has been approved, as in the example 'MD E3 17325'.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of each light source module. Pass if the identification code is present in the format 'MD' + E-number + approval number, and the code matches the approval of the lamp.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.1 after 1 min of operation (may be calculated from the distribution after photometric stability using the HV ratio); all test points within min/max limits.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.1 after 10 min of operation (may be calculated from the distribution after photometric stability using the HV ratio); all test points within min/max limits.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.2 after 1 min (may be calculated via HV ratio from 30 min or photometric stability distribution); all test points within min/max limits.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.2 after 30 min or after photometric stability; all test points within min/max limits.

requirements.text: For the stop lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.2 after 1 min (may be calculated via HV ratio from 30 min or photometric stability distribution); all test points within min/max limits.

requirements.text: For the stop lamp using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 8 para 1.2.2 after 30 min or after photometric stability; all test points within min/max limits.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the rear position lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, comply at 4 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate (Table A8-1).
requirements.test_case: Measure or calculate (ratio at HV) the intensity distribution 4 s after switch ON; all test points within min/max limits.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the stop lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, comply at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate (Table A8-1).
requirements.test_case: Measure or calculate (ratio at HV) the intensity distribution 0.2 s after switch ON; all test points within min/max limits.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the reversing lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, comply at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate (Table A8-1).
requirements.test_case: Measure or calculate (ratio at HV) the intensity distribution 0.2 s after switch ON; all test points within min/max limits.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflective device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2., or the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the device and drawings: a marking space exists that is large enough for the UI or approval marking plus the paragraph 3.3.4.2. markings.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection for legibility, then an indelibility check such as a rub test. Pass if the markings remain clearly legible.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be as defined in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval mark dimensions and compare them with the value for "a" in Table 1. Pass if the value is met.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the marking for the circle, the letter "E" and the country number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: a 4 to 6 digit sequential number matching the approval number is present.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: the sequential number is positioned adjacent to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: the class symbol (e.g. IA/IB) matching the approval is present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: "150R" followed by the correct two-digit series of amendments is present.

requirements.text: If the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
requirements.test_case: Visual comparison of the UI marking with the Figure I format.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: the applicant's trade name or mark is present.

requirements.text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the retro-reflective device shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Review the rotational symmetry against the manufacturer's prescribed angles. Where needed, visually confirm that a horizontal "TOP" is on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the device: the approval marking or UI, the trade name and any "TOP" mark are clearly legible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the marking shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on the vehicle (M1). Pass if the marking is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Design review and disassembly check. Pass if no light-transmitting part (outer lens, reversing window insert) can be removed without also removing the approval mark or UI.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mark components and compare them with the minimum sizes required by each applicable UN Regulation (e.g. R148, R150). Pass if none is below the smallest required minimum.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall meet the requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in those sections of UN Regulation No. 48, and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval, pertinent to the retro-reflecting device and to the vehicle category M1 on which it is intended to be installed, where their verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Review the retro-reflector design and its intended mounting position against UN R48 sections 5 and 6 and the referenced Annexes (e.g. position, geometric visibility, orientation, colour). Pass if every requirement that can be verified at device approval is met.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Design review and type-approval tests per UN R150 (photometric, heat resistance, water/dust penetration, corrosion, fuel/lubricating oil resistance); retro-reflector remains within photometric requirements after conditioning.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection and design/manufacturing review of samples; no defects found affecting operation or maintenance in good condition.

requirements.text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Manual dismantling attempt without tools on sample; retro-reflector components cannot be easily separated.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface; surface can be cleaned easily.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of outer surface of retro-reflector; no roughness, protuberances do not hinder cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the assembled lamp; inner retro-reflecting surface is enclosed and not accessible without dismantling.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, they shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Design review and manual separation attempt; optical unit and filter cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
requirements.test_case: Material/process documentation review and inspection; colour obtained by material colouring, no paint or varnish applied.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflector, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric test per UN R150 para. 4.2.1.2 / Annex 4 Part 1: verify the test set-up uses CIE Standard Illuminant A, a divergence angle of 1/3° and illumination angle β1=β2=0°, or the Annex 4 Part 1 para. 1.1 angle if a colourless surface reflection occurs. Pass: the set-up conforms.

requirements.text: When illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° (or the angle specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. if this produces a colourless surface reflection), the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates (x, y) of the retro-reflected light under the para. 4.2.1.2 conditions. Pass: the coordinates lie within the UN R48 night-time red retro-reflected colour boundaries.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of shape and dimensions per Annex 5 on all ten samples; pass if all Annex 5 requirements are met.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 and colorimetry per paragraph 4.2.1.; pass if paragraphs 5.1.4. and 5.1.5. are met.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Test sequence per Table 4 of paragraph 5.1.7.; pass if all samples meet the requirements after each test.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 (48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C) without distortion.
requirements.test_case: Part 1 of Annex 6: 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C on all ten samples, then visual inspection for distortion; pass if no distortion.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.test_case: Water 10 min normal and 10 min inverted position; motor fuels 5 min; oils 5 min; visual inspection, colorimetry and photometry at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if 5.1.3.2. met.

requirements.text: If necessary, the retro-reflector shall withstand the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6 and the abrasive-strength test of the rear face in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Corrosion 24 h + 2 h interval + 24 h; rear face 1 min; visual inspection, colorimetry, photometry at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if 5.1.3.2. met.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the test for stability in time of the optical properties in Part 3 of Annex 4 and the resistance to weathering test in Part 6 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Part 3 of Annex 4 and Part 6 of Annex 6, followed by colorimetry and photometry at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if 5.1.3.2. met.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetry per paragraph 4.2. (visual, trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt) after each test group; pass if red night-time colour limits are met.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have an RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0° after each test group; pass if RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx for red.

requirements.text: Where more than one or a range of axes of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the retro-reflector shall meet the photometric requirements with reference to each axis of reference or to the extreme axes of reference of the range specified.
requirements.test_case: Repeat photometric measurements per Part 1 of Annex 4 for each specified axis / extreme axes; pass if Table 3 minima met for each.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angle β1 = 0°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 3.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 para 3 photometry, α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angle β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 2.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 para 3 photometry, α = 20', β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 200 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' and illumination angle β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20° shall be equal to or greater than 1.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 para 3 photometry, α = 20', β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°; pass if RI ≥ 100 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angle β1 = 0°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 para 3 photometry, α = 1°30', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 5 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angle β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° shall be equal to or greater than 2.8∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 para 3 photometry, α = 1°30', β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 2.8 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI value of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' and illumination angle β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20° shall be equal to or greater than 2.5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 para 3 photometry, α = 1°30', β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°; pass if RI ≥ 2.5 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: RI values of the retro-reflector lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Photometric scan within the defined solid angle per Annex 4 Part 1; pass if no RI value below the applicable minimum.

requirements.text: If the Class IA or IB retro-reflector is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check declared mounting height; if < 750 mm, photometry downward angles limited to 5°.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the luminous flux reflected by the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates per paragraph 4.2.1.; pass if within UN R48 red night-time colour limits.

requirements.text: The mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall be considered conforming from a mechanical and geometric standpoint only if the differences from the approved type do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of UN R150.
requirements.test_case: Dimensional and visual inspection of random production samples against approved drawings; pass if deviations are within inevitable manufacturing tolerances and R150 requirements.

requirements.text: When testing the photometric performances of any retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in UN R150.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of randomly selected production retro-reflectors per R150 methods; pass if every measured value is at least 80 per cent of the prescribed minimum.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of production samples per R150; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the prescribed colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall conform to the requirements of this Regulation from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, with differences not exceeding inevitable manufacturing deviations.
requirements.test_case: Conformity of production check per Annex 3, paragraph 1.1: dimensional and mechanical inspection of randomly selected production samples against the approved type. Pass if differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

requirements.text: When testing the photometric performance of any retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of randomly selected production retro-reflectors per Annex 3, paragraph 1.2, disregarding devices with apparent defects. Pass if every measured value is at least 80 per cent of the prescribed minimum value.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall comply with the prescribed chromaticity coordinates.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of production samples per Annex 3, paragraph 1.3. Pass if the chromaticity coordinates lie within the boundaries prescribed for the retro-reflector colour.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is not marked "TOP", with an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the retro-reflector shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 photometry: at β1 = β2 = 0° (or angle of para. 5) and α = 20', rotate the device about its reference axis; find minimum RI; pass if it meets the para. 5 value.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is marked "TOP", with an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the retro-reflector shall be rotated about its axis ±5° and the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 1 photometry: at β1 = β2 = 0° and α = 20', rotate ±5° about reference axis from TOP position; pass if RI ≥ prescribed value throughout.

requirements.text: For testing the retro-reflection, the retro-reflector shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Verify light source calibration certificate for CIE Standard Illuminant A (2856 K) before photometry.

requirements.text: During photometric measurements of the retro-reflector, stray reflections should be avoided by appropriate masking.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of test set-up: masking applied around the retro-reflector and housing to avoid stray reflections.

requirements.text: The background to the retro-reflector sample and the framework of the sample holder should be matt black.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of test set-up: background and sample holder matt black.

requirements.text: The light source and photometer head should remain stable throughout the period of the retro-reflector test, and the laboratory ambient temperature should not vary significantly during this period.
requirements.test_case: Monitor source output, photometer reading and lab temperature during test; verify no significant drift.

requirements.text: Sufficient time should be allowed for the photometric apparatus to stabilize before commencing measurements of the retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Verify warm-up/stabilization period recorded before start of measurements.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the retro-reflective device of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1. of Annex 5, from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the retro-reflector illuminating surface from an observation distance of 10 m; pass if its shape cannot easily be confused with the equilateral triangle shape of Class IIIA/IIIB retro-reflectors.

requirements.text: In the resistance to heat test for moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices of Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 1, paragraph 1: place the retro-reflector sample in a dry-atmosphere oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 consecutive hours. Pass if the temperature and duration are logged within tolerance.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 1, paragraph 3: after the heat exposure and cooling, visually inspect the retro-reflector. Pass if no cracking and no appreciable distortion is visible, particularly on the optical component.

requirements.text: After the water penetration test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.test_case: After the Annex 6 Part 2 para. 1.1 immersions, visually inspect the reflecting surface; pass if no water has reached the reflecting surface.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after immersion; any clearly visible water on the reflecting surface = fail.

requirements.text: The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform, the collector having a height of 100 mm and an inside diameter of a minimum of 140 mm.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.1.3: measure precipitation with the specified collector; pass if 2.5 to 4.1 mm/min.

requirements.text: Since the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions shall be operated at design voltage during the water spray test according to a cycle of 5 min ON, 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.3: verify supply at design voltage and 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycling.

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.4: verify test duration of 12 cycles.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be formed in the interior of the device, nor shall one be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.2.6: inspect interior, then tap and tilt device; pass if no standing pool of water.

requirements.text: The test dust used shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.3.3: verify dust certificate to ASTM C 150-84.

requirements.text: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours, and the dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 para. 2.3.6: verify agitation timing (every 15 min, 2 to 15 s) over 5 hours with settling between.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so designed that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Corrosion test per Annex 6 Part 4 / ISO 9227:2017; after test, photometric and colorimetric characteristics within prescribed limits.

requirements.text: As the retro-reflector is combined with a lamp, the rear combination lamp shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Remove removable parts; saline mist exposure 24 h + 2 h drying + 24 h; verify test sequence completed.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Verify chamber temperature 35 °C ± 2 °C and solution 5 % NaCl by weight in distilled water with ≤ 0.02 % impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection immediately after salt mist test; pass if no excessive corrosion impairing efficiency.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery and cleaning, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≥ Table 9 value.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not more than the value in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery and cleaning, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≤ Table 10 value.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1.
requirements.test_case: Review exposure log against EN ISO 4892-2:2013 and Table A6-1 parameters; pass if conformant.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be exposed to accelerated artificial weathering for a period of 500 hours.
requirements.test_case: Verify exposure duration in the weathering log; pass if 500 hours completed.

requirements.text: When test method TM1 (Black-standard thermometer, cycle No. 1 according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013) is used, the exposure cycle shall be 102 min dry at a broadband irradiance (300 to 400 nm) of 60 ± 2 W/m², narrowband irradiance (340 nm) of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m², black-standard temperature of 65 ± 3 °C and relative humidity of 50 ± 10 %, followed by 18 min water spray at a broadband irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m² and narrowband irradiance of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m².
requirements.test_case: Check recorded chamber parameters for TM1 cycle; pass if all values remain within the stated tolerances under equilibrium conditions.

requirements.text: When test method TM2 (Black-panel thermometer, cycle No. 4 according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013) is used, the exposure cycle shall be 102 min dry at a broadband irradiance (300 to 400 nm) of 60 ± 2 W/m², narrowband irradiance (340 nm) of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m², black-panel temperature of 63 ± 3 °C and relative humidity of 50 ± 10 %, followed by 18 min water spray at a broadband irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m² and narrowband irradiance of 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m².
requirements.test_case: Check recorded chamber parameters for TM2 cycle; pass if all values remain within the stated tolerances under equilibrium conditions.

requirements.text: For the resistance to fuels test of the retro-reflective device, a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1 para. 1: prepare a test mixture of 70 vol. % n-heptane and 30 vol. % toluol and apply it to the retro-reflector sample. Pass if the mixture composition is verified before the test.

requirements.text: After the resistance to fuels test, the surface of the retro-reflective device must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1 para. 1.1(b): visually inspect the surface about 5 minutes after wiping with 70/30 n-heptane/toluol. Pass if there are no apparent surface changes; slight surface cracks are acceptable.

requirements.text: The approval number of the retro-reflective device shall be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval marking against paragraph 3.3. and Annex 10 Figure A10-I: the approval number is located adjacent to the circle surrounding the letter "E".

requirements.text: The digits constituting the approval number of the retro-reflective device shall face the same way as the "E".
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval marking: all approval number digits are oriented in the same direction as the letter "E".

requirements.text: The group of symbols indicating the class of the retro-reflective device shall be diametrically opposite the approval number.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the approval marking: the class symbol group is positioned diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the circle surrounding the "E".

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which the devices may be subjected, the devices retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of installed lamp on M1 vehicle and review of mounting design; after vibration exposure representative of normal use (paras 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1., 2.3.10.2.), verify the lamp remains securely fitted and photometric/colour/geometric visibility characteristics still meet R48 installation requirements. Pass: no loosening or displacement and all prescribed characteristics retained.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that it is not possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the mounting interface: verify positive location (e.g. locating pins, fixed fastener points) so the lamp can only be installed in the intended orientation and position and cannot shift during normal use or servicing. Pass: no inadvertent change of lamp position/aim possible.

requirements.text: The reference axis of each light-signalling device of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector), when fitted to the vehicle, shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Installation check on the M1 vehicle standing on a flat horizontal surface: measure the angle between the lamp reference axis and the road bearing plane; pass if the axis is parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: The reference axis of each light-signalling device of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector), when fitted to the vehicle, shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Installation check on the vehicle: measure the horizontal angle between the lamp reference axis and the vehicle median longitudinal plane for both the handed unit and its mirrored counterpart; pass if parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the rear combination lamp laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the installed lamp against the manufacturer's fitting instructions (mounting position, orientation, fasteners, seal); pass if all instructions are followed.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair (left- and right-hand side) shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this estimate being based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed left and right units on the vehicle (vehicle drawing / CMM) relative to the median longitudinal plane using the exterior geometrical form of the lamp; pass if the positions are symmetrical.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the exterior geometry (outer lens, housing, illuminating surfaces) of the left and right units by drawing/CAD mirror check; pass if they are mirror-symmetrical about the median longitudinal plane, ignoring internal structure.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps of the same function constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and retro-reflectors) shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the colour of the light emitted / retro-reflected by each function on both left and right units per the applicable device regulation (e.g. UN R148/R150); pass if both units of each pair meet the same colour requirements (red for position/stop/retro-reflector, white for reversing).

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps of the same function constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of each function on left and right units over the specified light distribution grid; pass if the intensity distributions are substantially identical (or, for a matched pair, the pair together complies with the photometric requirements).

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the installation requirements of paragraph 5.5 (symmetrical installation of the paired rear lamp functions) shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection and measurement of the installed left and right units on the vehicle: verify that geometric symmetry relative to the median longitudinal plane and the colour and photometric matching of each paired function are achieved as far as the asymmetrical body shape allows. Pass if any deviation from symmetry is attributable only to the vehicle's asymmetrical external shape.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Installation and design review against the colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connection requirements of UN R48 for each function; pass if every function individually complies while grouped/combined/reciprocally incorporated.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of each lamp function shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Photometric and colorimetric measurement of each function with all other functions of the module switched OFF; pass if each function meets its intensity distribution and colour requirements.

requirements.text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the stop lamp (and any other reciprocally incorporated function) with the rear position lamp simultaneously switched ON; pass if the colour remains within the prescribed red chromaticity limits.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either (a) the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Project the apparent surface parts in the direction of the reference axis onto a plane tangent to the outer lens; pass if projected area is not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or if the gap between facing edges of adjacent parts does not exceed 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch the rear position lamp ON and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period (photometer/colorimeter, visual check). Pass if no intentional variation occurs, unless permitted by specific instructions or paragraph 5.9.2.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the stop lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Activate the stop lamp and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period (photometer/colorimeter, visual check). Pass if no intentional variation occurs, unless permitted by specific instructions or paragraph 5.9.2.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the reversing lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Activate the reversing lamp and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over the ON period (photometer/colorimeter, visual check). Pass if no intentional variation occurs, unless permitted by specific instructions or paragraph 5.9.2.

requirements.text: If the photometric characteristics of a lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, then any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: For each permitted variation condition (ambient light change, other lamps ON/OFF, combined function use such as rear position and stop simultaneously), measure photometry and colour per the applicable device regulation (e.g. UN R148). Pass if all values remain within the prescribed limits for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear combination lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (rear position lamp, stop lamp and retro-reflector) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation check per paragraph 5.10.4.1 / Annex 4: observe from the front of the vehicle; pass if no red light from the rear lamp is visible.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of the vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, retro-reflector) if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 geometric check: observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle; pass if no part of the apparent surface of any red function is directly visible.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamps can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps (if they exist), the side-marker lamps (if they exist) and the rear registration plate lamp.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection and functional test: operate the lighting switch through all positions and check that the rear position lamps (both sides), front position lamps, any end-outline and side-marker lamps and the rear registration plate lamp always switch ON and OFF together. Pass: no switch state lights only some of these lamps, except in the conditions of paragraph 5.11.1.

requirements.text: The requirement for simultaneous switching of the rear position lamps with the front position lamps, end-outline marker lamps, side-marker lamps and rear registration plate lamp need not be met while one or more of the following conditions exist: (a) front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps; (b) side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators; (c) daytime running lamps are switched ON; (d) the front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle functional test: activate parking lamp mode, daytime running lamps and any front position lamp substitution under paragraph 5.12.1. Check that any switching that is not simultaneous happens only in these listed conditions. Pass: all other operating states meet paragraph 5.11.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light (chromaticity per R48 para 2 definitions / R148 colour specs); pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within white boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of stop lamp emitted light through outer lens; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of rear position lamp emitted light through outer lens; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the light reflected by the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric check of retro-reflected light under standard illuminant A; pass if chromaticity within red boundaries.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors fitted (handed left and right units); pass if each count equals the number indicated in the individual specifications of UN R48 for M1 vehicles.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector of the rear combination lamp is fitted as an additional lamp for the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. and is switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, it shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation check: open the movable component to each fixed open position, verify the body-mounted rear position lamp is switched ON and that its mounting position, geometric visibility angles and photometric values meet the requirements applicable to the lamps on the movable component; pass if all are met.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position (stable or natural rest position(s) specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not) different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection on M1 vehicle: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed position and determine the obscured fraction of the rear position lamp apparent surface in the reference axis direction; pass if obscuration is no more than 50 per cent.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position (stable or natural rest position(s) specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not) different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection on M1 vehicle: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed position and determine the obscured fraction of the retro-reflector apparent surface in the reference axis direction; pass if obscuration is no more than 50 per cent.

requirements.text: If the 50 per cent obscuration requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable for the rear position lamp, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Functional check: move the movable component to each fixed position where the rear position lamp is more than 50 per cent hidden with position lamps ON; pass if the additional lamps switch ON and meet position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps.

requirements.text: If the 50 per cent obscuration requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable for the retro-reflector, additional devices satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for retro-reflectors shall be provided and effective when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the retro-reflector is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection: with the movable component in each fixed position hiding more than 50 per cent of the retro-reflector, verify additional retro-reflecting devices are exposed and meet position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear retro-reflectors.

requirements.text: If neither paragraph 5.21 nor 5.21.1 is practicable for the rear position lamp, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road; this alternative does not apply to retro-reflectors.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify presence and content of the user notice in the vehicle for movable component positions hiding more than 50 per cent of the rear position lamp; verify this alternative is not used for the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: With the exception of the retro-reflector, each lamp of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp), even bearing an approval mark, shall be capable of being made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; otherwise it is deemed not to be present.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the lamp installed on the M1 vehicle: with the light source(s) present and/or the fuse installed and no other modification, activate each function (rear position, stop, reversing) via the vehicle controls. Pass if each function operates; fail if any function requires additional wiring, components or modification to operate.

requirements.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is used, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the rear position lamp light sources. Measure the chromaticity of the replacement function according to the colour requirements for the rear position lamp. Pass if the replacement emits red light similar to the original function.

requirements.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is used, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in main intensity to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the rear position lamp. Measure the luminous intensity of the replacement function in the photometric test points for the rear position lamp. Pass if the main intensity is similar to the original rear position lamp function and within its limits.

requirements.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is used, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in position to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation drawings and the lamp. Compare the location (height, width, lateral position) of the replacement function's illuminating surface with that of the original rear position lamp. Pass if the positions are similar and meet the rear position lamp installation requirements.

requirements.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is used, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: While the replacement is active, activate the original function of the replacement device (e.g. apply the brake). Pass if the original function operates and meets its photometric requirements.

requirements.text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the rear position lamp with the replacement active on the vehicle. Pass if the dashboard tell-tale switches on, indicating a temporary replacement and need for repair, for the whole replacement period.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control responding simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., then the intensity of these lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Vary the controlling condition (environmental/traffic) over the full control range and measure luminous intensity of both functions; pass if both functions vary together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 have variable luminous intensity control, then in the entire intensity range the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop lamp and rear position lamp intensities at multiple points across the intensity range and during transitions; pass if the prescribed stop/position intensity ratio is maintained throughout.

requirements.text: If the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp (R2) or stop lamp (S2) is increased or decreased in relation to ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds or contamination of the light emitting surface, then the variation shall remain within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
requirements.test_case: Simulate each environmental condition input and measure luminous intensity at minimum and maximum settings per the photometric test of the pertinent Regulation (e.g. UN R148); pass if intensities stay within the prescribed min/max limits.

requirements.text: Independent from environmental conditions, a decrease of the luminous intensity of the rear position lamp (R2) and stop lamp (S2) shall only be activated, within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, when the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m.
requirements.test_case: On vehicle/HIL, vary speed and following distance signals; pass if the decrease activates only at speed ≤ 20 km/h or following distance ≤ 20 m and the reduced intensity is within the prescribed limits.

requirements.text: A traffic-condition intensity decrease already activated for the rear position lamp (R2) and stop lamp (S2) shall not remain active when the vehicle speed exceeds 50 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Activate the decrease, then raise speed signal above 50 km/h; pass if the decrease is cancelled above 50 km/h (it may remain active up to 50 km/h).

requirements.text: No sharp variation of intensity of the rear position lamp and stop lamp shall be observed during transition of the variable luminous intensity.
requirements.test_case: Record luminous intensity versus time during intensity transitions (photodetector/oscilloscope); pass if transitions are gradual with no step or sharp change observed.

requirements.text: When the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the M1 category, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the rear combination lamp functions, if they have been tested according to their type approval documentation by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure the voltage at the lamp terminals on the vehicle in a constant voltage operating condition representative for M1, as specified by the applicant. Compare it with the voltage stated in the lamp type approval documentation. Pass if the measured value does not exceed the approved voltage. Confirm the exemption first by checking the lamp documentation for electronic light source control gear, an integrated variable intensity control, or only R128 light sources.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the rear combination lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the M1 category. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: With the vehicle electrical system in a representative constant voltage operating condition, measure the voltage at the terminals of each lamp function. Pass if the voltage is ≤ 6.95 V (6 V system), ≤ 13.905 V (12 V system) or ≤ 28.84 V (24 V system). Check the exemption according to paragraph 5.27.3. first.

requirements.text: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the rear combination lamp may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device.
requirements.test_case: Design review: if voltage limiting is integrated in the lamp housing, verify that the voltage at the light source terminals complies with paragraph 5.27.2. when the lamp is supplied by the vehicle.

requirements.text: When the lamp is installed on the vehicle, there shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity; however, no account is taken of obstacles if they were already present when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection or CAD sight-line check on the M1 vehicle: observe the apparent surface of each function from infinity (parallel directions) over its full angles of geometric visibility. Pass if no vehicle part obstructs light from any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles already present at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Where masking is identified, carry out photometric measurement of the installed or masked unit, or a simulation with masking applied, at the test points of the device approval regulation. Pass if all prescribed photometric values are still met by the unhidden part.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1. If it is below 750 mm, verify the photometric field down to 5° below the horizontal only. Pass if all photometric values within the reduced field comply.

requirements.text: A LED module of the rear combination lamp may be non-replaceable only if this is stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
requirements.test_case: Document and design review: check whether each LED module can be replaced. Pass if the module is replaceable, or if it is non-replaceable and the communication sheet of the component (lamp) type approval states that it is non-replaceable.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector functions), when installed on a vehicle, shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Document review: verify valid type approvals per corresponding device Regulations (e.g. UN R148 for position/stop/reversing lamps, UN R150 for retro-reflector) and corresponding approval markings on the device; pass if each installed function is covered by an approval.

requirements.text: If the light-signalling lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of lamp for manufacturer logo within apparent surface; if present, verify UN R148 type approval covering the logo (including logo provisions of UN R148 para. 4.5.5); pass if approval exists and marking is present.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify at least one reversing lamp is fitted; pass if present.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device shall be optional.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count reversing lamps fitted; pass if 1 or 2 devices are installed.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify a valid UN R23 (00 or later series) or UN R148 (00 or later series) approval mark on the lamp; pass if present and valid.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the illuminating surface above ground on unladen vehicle per R48 measurement provisions; pass if 250 mm <= height <= 1,200 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify lamp is mounted at the vehicle rear; pass if rear-mounted.

requirements.text: For a reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angle α as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7.: verify unobstructed apparent surface over α = +15°/-5°; pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: If there are two reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7. shall be 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7.: verify visibility over β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards for each lamp; pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the reference axis of the lamp points rearwards; pass if rearward-oriented.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: engage reverse with propulsion system operable; pass if lamp switches ON only under both conditions.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: disengage reverse, then separately switch propulsion system to non-operable; pass if lamp is OFF and cannot be switched ON in each case.

requirements.text: A tell-tale for the reversing lamp is optional; however a tell-tale indicating failure shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check component regulation (R23/R148) requirements; if failure tell-tale is required, simulate lamp failure and verify tell-tale activation; pass if indicated.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on M1 category vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

requirements.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the S1/S2 stop lamps; pass if exactly two (one per mirrored rear combination lamp).

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document check: verify approval marking and certificate to UN R7 02 series or later or UN R148 00 series or later; pass if valid approval exists.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface of the S1 or S2 category stop lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface in the reference axis direction to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the stop lamp apparent surface above ground per paragraph 5.8.1 with vehicle unladen; pass if 350 mm ≤ height ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork justifies and no optional lamps are installed).

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle in length.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the stop lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle; pass if located at rear.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check apparent surface visibility on vehicle over 45° outward and inward horizontally; pass if apparent surface unobstructed over the full angles.

requirements.text: For S1 and S2 category stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward horizontal angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, check inward visibility under H plane down to 20°; pass if unobstructed over at least 20° inward below the H plane.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Check apparent surface visibility on vehicle over 15° up and 15° down; pass if unobstructed over the full angles.

requirements.text: Where the S1 or S2 category stop lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward vertical angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, check downward visibility; pass if unobstructed over at least 5° downward.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify reference axis of stop lamp points rearwards; pass if oriented to rear.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: apply brake signal per UN R13-H and observe all stop lamps; pass if all illuminate simultaneously.

requirements.text: The stop lamps need not function if the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: with propulsion start/stop device in off position, apply brake; stop lamp operation is permitted but not required; pass in either case, and verify lamps function when propulsion system can operate.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamp shall be provided if required by the component regulation; otherwise the tell-tale is optional.
requirements.test_case: Check component approval (UN R7/R148) requirements; if failure tell-tale required, simulate stop lamp failure and verify tell-tale activates; pass if tell-tale indicates failure.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps (devices of R or R1 or R2 categories) shall be mandatory on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are installed on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the rear position lamps; pass if exactly two (one per side, handed units).

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify approval mark/certificate to UN R7 (02 series or later) or UN R148 (00 series or later) for the rear position lamp function; pass if valid approval present.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle measurement: measure distance from outermost point of the apparent surface in the reference axis direction to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

requirements.text: In height, the rear position lamp shall be located above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle measurement per paragraph 5.8.1 on unladen vehicle: measure lowest and highest points of the apparent surface above ground; pass if ≥ 350 mm and ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork shape justifies and no optional lamps).

requirements.text: In length, the rear position lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the lamp is mounted at the rear of the vehicle; pass if located at the rear.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 45° inwards and 80° outwards in the horizontal angle; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle/drawing: verify unobstructed apparent surface over 45° inward and 80° outward (inward 20° below H plane if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible over the full angles.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal in the vertical angle; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle/drawing: verify unobstructed apparent surface over 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible over the full angles.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: If alternative is claimed: verify rear side-marker lamp fitted, then check unobstructed visibility 45° outward to 45° inward (20° inward below H plane if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible over the angles.
