requirements.text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, the vertical angle of the rear position lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check: verify visibility 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible over the angles.

requirements.text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, to be considered visible the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light being excluded.
requirements.test_case: CAD/vehicle projection at each boundary angle: compute unobstructed apparent surface of the rear position lamp excluding the non-light-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify reference axis of the lamp points rearwards; pass if oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Wiring diagram and functional check: verify rear position lamps are switched ON/OFF together with front position lamps, end-outline marker lamps (if any), side-marker lamps (if any) and rear registration plate lamp per paragraph 5.11; pass if compliant.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps shall be mandatory and shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle functional check: switch on position lamps and verify a closed-circuit tell-tale, common with the front position lamps, illuminates; pass if tell-tale present and combined.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check component approval (UN R7/R148) conditions; if failure tell-tale required, simulate lamp failure and verify failure tell-tale activates; pass if indication given.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection on an M1 vehicle: verify rear non-triangular retro-reflectors are fitted; pass if present.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Inspect vehicle and approval markings of left and right units: pass if exactly two mandatory retro-reflectors are fitted, each bearing Class IA or IB approval to UN R3 02+ series or UN R150 00+ series.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) shall be permitted only provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Visual and photometric review of the installation: pass if any additional retro-reflecting devices/materials do not impair visibility or performance of the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the lowest point of the illuminating surface above ground with vehicle at specified load condition; pass if ≥ 250 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not more than 900 mm above the ground, or not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), or 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the highest point of the illuminating surface above ground; pass if ≤ 1,200 mm when grouped with the rear combination lamp functions (≤ 1,500 mm only where bodywork shape makes compliance impossible, justified).

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: pass if the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be 30° inwards and outwards in the horizontal angle.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle/CAD: pass if the illuminating surface is unobstructed over 30° inwards and 30° outwards.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be 10° above and below horizontal in the vertical angle; however, where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle/CAD: pass if unobstructed 10° up and 10° down (5° down acceptable if mounting height < 750 mm per 5.8.1).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Installation inspection of reference axis: pass if the retro-reflector reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the retro-reflector shall be permitted to have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Design review: shared surfaces between retro-reflector and rear position/stop/reversing lamp apparent surfaces are acceptable; confirm other requirements remain met.

requirements.text: When verifying, according to paragraph 5.10.4., that no red light from the rear combination lamp is visible to the front and no white light other than from the reversing lamp is visible to the rear, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Install the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground. Have an observer explore zone 1 (front) and zone 2 (rear) between horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground. Pass: within these heights, no red light from the lamp is visible from the front and no white light other than from the reversing lamp is visible from the rear.

requirements.text: When verifying visibility of a red lamp to the front and of a white lamp to the rear, the zones 1 and 2 shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes that form, to the front and to the rear respectively, an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane. These planes shall pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane that delimit the vehicle's overall width.
requirements.test_case: Determine the overall-width contact points of the vehicle. Construct vertical planes at 15° outwards from the median longitudinal plane through these points, to the front and to the rear. Pass: within the zones bounded by these planes, no red light from the lamp is visible from the front and no white light other than from the reversing lamp is visible from the rear.

requirements.text: If there are several points of contact delimiting the vehicle's overall width, the foremost point shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost point to the rearward plane bounding the visibility zones.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle body for multiple overall-width contact points. Pass: zone 1 is constructed through the foremost contact point and zone 2 through the rearmost contact point.

requirements.text: The position of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector of the rear combination lamp, in width, in height and in length, shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation, and the values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: COP check on production vehicle: measure lamp positions in width, height and length per paras 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4.; pass if measured distances meet each lamp's individual installation specifications.

requirements.text: The angles of geometric visibility of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation, and the values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: COP check on production vehicle: measure geometric visibility angles per para 2.10.7.; pass if angles meet each lamp's individual specifications, with an allowance of ±3º (para 5.3.).

requirements.text: The visibility of red light from the rear position lamp, stop lamp and retro-reflector towards the front shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: COP check on production vehicle per para 5.10.: pass if no red light is directly visible from the front in the zone defined in para 5.10.

requirements.text: The visibility of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: COP check on production vehicle per para 5.10.: pass if white light towards the rear is only emitted by the reversing lamp as permitted by para 5.10.

requirements.text: The rear position, stop and reversing lamps and their tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: COP functional check on production vehicle against paras 5.11. to 5.14. and individual lamp specifications (e.g. stop lamp on braking, reversing lamp on reverse gear with ignition on, position lamp with headlamps); pass if all conditions met.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings, and shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: COP visual inspection on production vehicle of lamps and markings; pass if presence, number, colour (red for position/stop/retro-reflector, white for reversing), arrangement and category comply with paras 5.15., 5.16. and individual lamp specifications.
